description: Unit tests for multi-threaded proxy resolver in Chromium, including mock resolvers, thread management, and request handling scenarios.

classes.name: MockProxyResolver

classes.description: Factory producing BlockableProxyResolver instances, tracks created resolvers and script data.

classes.name: SingleShotMultiThreadedProxyResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory that creates a single ProxyResolver for multi-threaded resolver.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolverTest
classes.description: Test fixture for multi-threaded proxy resolver, includes setup and various test cases.
